policy: All 101 original nominees remain in scope. A source failure is not a missing horse. Recent-form windows are never substituted for full-career statistics. Ratings systems remain separate and missing ratings are never inferred.

recentFormIntegrity.note: Evidence-backed false duplicate dates have been excluded and the canonical recent-form window rebuilt.

ratingsCoverage.unavailablePolicy: No R&S value is inferred where an explicitly labelled public R&S rating cannot be found. Timeform, RSSR, official handicap ratings, Racing.com WPR and unlabelled numeric fields are not substitutes.

freshPublicEvidence.scope: Highwayman chronological preparation/stakes context: Persian King colt trained by Joseph O'Brien; source records first four starts without a top-seven finish followed by three consecutive wins in a Killarney maiden, Listed Vinnie Roe Stakes and G1 Betfred St Leger at Doncaster under Saffie Osborne. Melbourne Cup described as quite possible subject to wellbeing and owners. No numeric R&S rating is published in this article and none is inferred.

Wine Dark Sea fresh travel/campaign update: Harry Charlton; Australian Bloodstock ownership interest; Damian Lane expected to ride; currently in UK quarantine with Melbourne flight planned after one further week; Caulfield Cup first Australian target then Melbourne Cup; 2026 campaign includes Ascot and Carlisle handicap wins, a Newmarket defeat and 1.5L G3 Geoffrey Freer Stakes win at Newbury. No rating inferred.
